messages:
emily: Heads-up: finance spotted ~18 refunds that created inconsistent NetSuite state. Stripe shows refunds, but some invoices gained credits twice and others show no credit. Window ~2026-04-02 04:10-04:40 UTC.

diego: Any sign of webhook reordering or seq gaps? We recently tweaked the kinesis consumer checkpointing.

ops-bot: [auto] ingest-lag metric spike detected 2026-04-02T04:12:00Z consumer=webhook-ingest delta=+2m

emily: I pulled raw events from archive and see some sequence numbers out of order (seq 1003 arrived after seq 1008). Looks like a transient Kinesis retry + shard-split caused reorder. Our apply-worker assumes strict monotonic seq per invoice which is failing.

sam: That would explain duplicates when a late refund triggers an apply after the original apply already processed. We need to make apply idempotent by using event_id + invoice_id instead of seq-only.

ops-bot: [auto] dlq: suppressed_count=14 path=s3://redwood-prod/webhooks/suppressed/2026-04-02/

diego: Short-term plan: 1) run a targeted replay that sorts events by event_created_at before applying, 2) backfill any missing applies, 3) patch consumer to tolerate reorder.

emily: I exported the affected payloads and ran a local dry-run: 18 events -> 16 applies, 2 duplicates skipped. Dry-run CSV at ./dryruns/seqgap_2026-04-02.csv

sam: Ops, please schedule a 10-min window to run the replay with `--sort-by=created_at` and `--idempotency=event+invoice`. Also annotate NetSuite memos if invoice is closed.

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job queued job_id=seqgap_2026_42 queued_by=diego eta=2026-04-02T05:00:00Z

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job started job_id=seqgap_2026_42 status=dry_run_started

diego: Dry-run matched expected applies. Scheduling real run in 10m. Will keep suppression toggled true and replay bypassing suppressor only for these keys.

emily: Finance will review changes and approve memos. Please attach mapping of stripe_refund -> ns_txn_id for audit.

ops-bot: [auto] replay-job completed job_id=seqgap_2026_42 applied=16 skipped_duplicates=2 memos_created=1 failures=0

audit-bot: [auto] replay-audit rec_id=replay_seqgap_42 artifacts=s3://redwood-prod/replay/seqgap_2026_42/applies.csv

diego: Follow-ups: (1) patch consumer checkpointing to use per-invoice vector clock, (2) add a reconciler that detects seq gaps and auto-enqueues sorted replay, (3) add prometheus alert for reorder_rate > 0.05%

emily: Finance confirmed balances reconcile. Filing postmortem and runbook for sorted replays. Closing once PM reviews.
